system:
You write triage summaries of companies for a team that vets suppliers and project partners. The reader has about 30 seconds and must decide whether the company deserves a closer look.

Rules:
1. Use ONLY the facts provided. Never calculate, estimate or add outside knowledge. Copy figures exactly as written.
2. Lead with what matters most: the HIGH signals first, then MEDIUM. Mention INFO signals only if they add useful context.
3. If financial statements are missing, say so plainly. Never imply figures that are not provided.
4. State which financial year the latest figures are from, because they may be out of date.
5. Court cases that are not listed under the signals are settled, withdrawn, dismissed, or brought by the company itself. Do not present them as concerns.
6. Be neutral and factual. Do not recommend for or against doing business with the company.
7. 70 to 110 words. Plain Markdown, no headings.
prompt:
Write the summary for this company.

Structure: one opening sentence saying what the company is (name, industry, state, year incorporated), then the most important risks and facts, with the most serious first. If there are no significant signals, say so and give the headline financial position instead.

Company: Sejahtera Cahaya Technologies Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000785)
Industry: Technology | State: Kuala Lumpur | Status: Active
Business: Mobile app development for e-commerce clients
Incorporated: 1994-04-19 | Share capital: RM500,000
Board: 5 director(s); 0 appointed in the 12 months to 31 Dec 2025
Largest shareholder: 100.0%
Financial years available: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (latest year end 2024-12-31)
FY2022: revenue RM15.47m, profit after tax -RM1.88m, equity RM5.34m, operating cash flow -RM1.47m, audit: Unqualified
FY2023: revenue RM14.98m, profit after tax -RM2.25m, equity RM3.09m, operating cash flow -RM1.80m, audit: Unqualified
FY2024: revenue RM13.38m, profit after tax -RM2.69m, equity RM396,674, operating cash flow -RM1.76m, audit: Unqualified
Court cases: 0 total (0 as defendant, 0 as plaintiff); open cases against company: 0
Risk and context signals (computed, already verified):
- [HIGH] Loss-making in each of the last 3 years; latest loss -RM2.69m (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Revenue fell 14% from RM15.47m (FY2022) to RM13.38m (FY2024).
- [MEDIUM] Operating cash flow was negative (-RM1.76m) in FY2024.
- [MEDIUM] Operating profit does not cover interest expense in FY2024 (cover -23.9x).
- [INFO] One shareholder holds 100.0% of the company.
- [INFO] Part-owned by other companies: Mutiara Holdings Sdn. Bhd. (100.0%).
response:
Sejahtera Cahaya Technologies Sdn. Bhd. is a Kuala Lumpur-based technology company incorporated on 1994-04-19 that develops mobile apps for e-commerce clients. 

The company presents multiple financial risks, beginning with consecutive losses in each of the last three years, reaching -RM2.69m in FY2024. Revenue fell 14% from RM15.47m in FY2022 to RM13.38m in FY2024. Additionally, operating cash flow was negative at -RM1.76m in FY2024, and operating profit failed to cover interest expense (cover -23.9x). Equity dropped to RM396,674 by FY2024. Audits for all available years, ending 2024-12-31, were unqualified. One shareholder holds 100.0% of the company.
